title: Fibre to the cabinet (FTTC) broadband
summary: Part-fibre broadband where the last stretch from the street cabinet uses copper phone line.

sections.label: Speeds
sections.body: Download speeds up to 66Mbps and upload up to 18Mbps, depending on how far your home is from the cabinet.

sections.label: What's included
sections.body: Unlimited data, a Lumenet Hub router, and a landline-ready phone socket without a line rental charge.

sections.label: Availability
sections.body: Available to most UK homes with a working phone line; enter your postcode in the checker to confirm.

sections.label: Costs
sections.body: Monthly price is fixed for the minimum term; a one-off activation fee applies unless you buy online.

title: Full fibre (FTTP) broadband
summary: Fibre all the way into your home for faster, more reliable speeds.

sections.label: Speeds
sections.body: Plans from 150Mbps up to 900Mbps download, with upload speeds matched to the plan.

sections.label: Equipment
sections.body: An engineer fits an ONT box on your wall and connects it to your Lumenet Hub 2 router.

sections.label: Installation
sections.body: Installation takes up to three hours and may need a drill hole in an outside wall.

sections.label: Costs
sections.body: Monthly price depends on speed; a free installation applies to online orders on 24-month contracts.

title: Gigabit and ultrafast plans
summary: Our fastest plans for large households and heavy users, up to 1Gbps.

sections.label: Speeds
sections.body: Up to 1,000Mbps download and 1,000Mbps upload, with the typical evening speed shown on the plan page.

sections.label: Who it suits
sections.body: Homes with many devices, 4K streaming, large downloads and people who work with big files.

sections.label: Equipment needed
sections.body: A Lumenet Hub 3 with 2.5Gbps ports and a Cat6 cable for the best speeds on wired devices.

sections.label: Costs
sections.body: Premium price per month; first three months at a discount for new customers.

title: Choosing the right plan
summary: A simple guide to matching a plan to the number of people and devices in your home.

sections.label: How many people use it
sections.body: One or two people can use 50Mbps; a household of four should look at 150Mbps or more.

sections.label: What you do online
sections.body: Streaming in HD needs about 5Mbps per stream; video calls and gaming add to the load.

sections.label: Comparing plans
sections.body: View all plans side by side by speed, price, minimum term and included extras.

sections.label: Changing plan later
sections.body: You can upgrade at any time; downgrading before the end of your term may attract a fee.

title: Typical speeds and the evening range
summary: What speeds you can expect at different times of day and how we measure them.

sections.label: Typical evening speed
sections.body: The speed delivered to at least half of customers between 8pm and 10pm is shown for every plan.

sections.label: Why speeds vary
sections.body: Distance from the cabinet, wiring in your home, Wi-Fi interference and the number of devices all matter.

sections.label: Measuring your speed
sections.body: Use the Lumenet speed test on a wired device with no other use for the most accurate result.

sections.label: Range of speeds
sections.body: Your address-specific range appears in your order confirmation.

title: Minimum speed guarantee
summary: The lowest speed we guarantee at your address and what happens if you are below it.

sections.label: Your guaranteed minimum
sections.body: Your guaranteed minimum download speed is shown in your order confirmation and in My Lumenet.

sections.label: If your speed is below the guarantee
sections.body: Run three wired speed tests and contact us; we investigate and fix the fault within 30 days.

sections.label: If we cannot fix it
sections.body: You can leave without paying early termination charges within the first 90 days or after the fix window.

sections.label: Exceptions
sections.body: The guarantee excludes Wi-Fi speeds and problems caused by your own equipment.

title: What Mbps means
summary: A plain explanation of megabits, download, upload and latency.

sections.label: Download speed
sections.body: How quickly data comes to you, which affects streaming, browsing and downloading files.

sections.label: Upload speed
sections.body: How fast data leaves your home, important for video calls, backups and posting videos.

sections.label: Latency
sections.body: The delay in milliseconds before a request gets a reply; lower is better for gaming and calls.

sections.label: Megabits and megabytes
sections.body: 8 megabits make a megabyte, so 100Mbps downloads about 12MB each second.

title: Current deals and offers
summary: Our latest promotions on plans, mobile and TV, including cashback and free months.

sections.label: Broadband deals
sections.body: Selected plans have a monthly discount for the first six or twelve months, shown at checkout.

sections.label: Cashback and vouchers
sections.body: Reward cards are sent within 60 days of your service going live and are valid for 12 months.

sections.label: Offer rules
sections.body: Offers may change without notice and cannot be combined unless stated.

sections.label: How to claim
sections.body: Use the link on the offer page and enter the code at checkout before ordering.

title: Student and over-65 discounts
summary: Reduced prices for students and customers over 65.

sections.label: Student deal
sections.body: Reduced monthly price with a nine-month contract matched to the academic year, for full-time students.

sections.label: Over-65 plan
sections.body: A lower monthly rate on selected plans for customers aged 65 or over, with priority support.

sections.label: Proof you need
sections.body: A student ID or university letter, or proof of age, which you can upload in My Lumenet.

sections.label: Social tariff
sections.body: A discounted plan is available if you receive Universal Credit or another qualifying benefit.

title: Loyalty and upgrade offers
summary: Rewards for existing customers who stay or upgrade.

sections.label: Loyalty price
sections.body: Existing customers can receive a rolling discount that applies if you renew early.

sections.label: Upgrade offers
sections.body: Move to a faster plan or full fibre and receive a free router upgrade.

sections.label: When to ask
sections.body: Contact us 30 to 60 days before your contract ends to see what is available.

sections.label: Price protection
sections.body: Some loyalty offers include a fixed price for the next 24 months.

title: Check availability at your address
summary: How to find out which services you can order at your address.

sections.label: Using the checker
sections.body: Enter your postcode and select your address; we show every plan you can order and the expected speed range.

sections.label: If fibre is not available
sections.body: We offer the best available alternative and can register your interest for full fibre in your area.

sections.label: Planned upgrades
sections.body: The build programme page lists streets and dates where full fibre will arrive.

sections.label: Shared buildings
sections.body: Flats and managed buildings may need landlord permission before we can install.

title: Installation and activation day
summary: What happens before, during and after we connect your service.

sections.label: Before the day
sections.body: We confirm a four-hour appointment window and tell you if an engineer visit is needed.

sections.label: During the visit
sections.body: The engineer tests the line, fits any socket or box and helps you connect your router.

sections.label: Self-install
sections.body: If you only need a plug-in, we send a router with a start date and instructions.

sections.label: If you are not home
sections.body: Someone over 18 must be present; rearrange for free at least 24 hours before.

title: Switching to Lumenet
summary: How to move your broadband from another provider without losing service.

sections.label: What to do
sections.body: Order your new plan and give your current provider's name; we arrange the switch for you.

sections.label: Notice and charges
sections.body: Check your current contract for early leaving charges before the switch date.

sections.label: Switching date
sections.body: Your service moves on the activation date; keep the old equipment until it works.

sections.label: If something goes wrong
sections.body: Contact us within seven days and we will resolve the problem or return you to your old provider.

title: Business broadband
summary: Plans, static IP and support for small businesses and the self-employed.

sections.label: Plans
sections.body: Business plans have speed boosts, a four-hour fix target and optional 4G backup.

sections.label: Static IP and extras
sections.body: Optional static IP address, hosted email and a business phone line.

sections.label: Business contract terms
sections.body: Minimum 24 months; VAT is added to prices on business plans.

sections.label: Moving or changing a business
sections.body: Contact business support to move premises or change company details.

title: SIM-only plans
summary: Monthly plans with no handset, on 1, 12 or 24 month terms.

sections.label: Plan sizes
sections.body: From 5GB to unlimited data, with unlimited minutes and texts on all plans.

sections.label: Contract lengths
sections.body: Choose a 1-month rolling plan or 12 or 24 months with a lower price.

sections.label: What's included
sections.body: 5G where available, UK roaming and a monthly spending cap.

sections.label: Ordering
sections.body: Order online; your SIM arrives in 2 working days.

title: eSIM
summary: Activate a plan on a compatible phone using a digital SIM, with no plastic card.

sections.label: What is an eSIM
sections.body: A SIM built into your phone that you activate with a QR code from My Lumenet.

sections.label: Compatible devices
sections.body: Most phones released since 2019; see the list of supported models.

sections.label: Switching to eSIM
sections.body: Request a replacement in My Lumenet; your number moves after you scan the code.

sections.label: If it will not activate
sections.body: Check Wi-Fi, restart the phone and re-scan; contact support if the QR code has been used.

title: Keep your number: PAC and STAC codes
summary: How to move your mobile number to or from Lumenet.

sections.label: Moving your number to us
sections.body: Ask your old provider for a PAC code by text (send PAC to 65075) and give it to us when ordering.

sections.label: Moving your number away
sections.body: Text PAC to 65075; we send the code within one minute and it lasts 30 days.

sections.label: Cancelling and codes
sections.body: Your account closes when your number leaves; any outstanding charges are billed afterwards.

sections.label: Cancelling a switch
sections.body: Contact us before the switch date to stop it.

title: Phone plans with a handset
summary: Monthly plans that include a new phone with a fixed repayment.

sections.label: How it works
sections.body: You pay a monthly plan charge plus a device payment over 24 or 36 months.

sections.label: Credit check
sections.body: A credit check is needed; the device cost is a loan agreement.

sections.label: Choosing your handset
sections.body: Compare phones side by side with trade-in values and storage options.

sections.label: Ending early
sections.body: Repay the remaining device balance to leave before the end of the term.

title: Upgrading your phone
summary: When you can upgrade and how to trade in your old handset.

sections.label: When you can upgrade
sections.body: Upgrade after 12 months by paying off 50% of the handset balance.

sections.label: Trade-in
sections.body: Send your old phone and receive a credit on your bill within 30 days.

sections.label: Keeping your plan
sections.body: Your plan and number stay the same; the handset payment changes.

sections.label: Checking your eligibility
sections.body: See your date and balance in My Lumenet under My Mobile.

title: Handset protection and repairs
summary: Optional insurance and repair service for broken, lost or stolen phones.

sections.label: What's covered
sections.body: Accidental damage, loss, theft and mechanical breakdown, with an excess per claim.

sections.label: How to claim
sections.body: Claim in My Lumenet and send in a damaged phone or collect a replacement from a store.

sections.label: Lost or stolen phones
sections.body: Block the SIM at once through the app or helpline; keep the crime reference number.

sections.label: Cost
sections.body: Monthly fee depends on the value of the phone; cancel at any time.

title: Using your phone in Europe
summary: What it costs to use your plan in the EU and nearby countries.

sections.label: Roaming allowance
sections.body: Up to 25GB per month in EU countries at no extra charge, with a fair use limit above that.

sections.label: Countries included
sections.body: The EU, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein; other European countries use a daily pass.

sections.label: Data cap
sections.body: After the allowance, data is charged at £3 per GB until you reach your spending cap.

sections.label: Before you travel
sections.body: Check roaming is switched on in your phone and turn off automatic updates.

title: Roaming outside Europe
summary: Daily passes and rates for the USA, Australia and the rest of the world.

sections.label: Travel pass
sections.body: A £7 daily pass lets you use your UK allowance in over 80 destinations; it is charged only on days you use it.

sections.label: Standard rates
sections.body: Without a pass, data, calls and texts are charged at pay-as-you-go rates for each country.

sections.label: Cruises and aeroplanes
sections.body: Charged at special maritime or in-flight rates, which are much higher.

sections.label: Pass not working
sections.body: Restart the phone, check roaming is on and contact us if the pass does not activate.

title: Spending caps and bill shock
summary: How to limit extra charges for roaming and premium services.

sections.label: Default spend cap
sections.body: A £40 monthly cap applies to out-of-bundle charges unless you change it.

sections.label: Changing your cap
sections.body: Set or remove a cap in the Lumenet app under Usage and limits.

sections.label: Alerts
sections.body: We text you when you reach 80% and 100% of your allowance or cap.

sections.label: Premium rate services
sections.body: Calls to premium numbers and subscriptions are barred by default for new accounts.

title: Data allowances and fair use
summary: How much data your plan includes and what happens if you use all of it.

sections.label: Allowance
sections.body: Your plan shows the monthly data in GB; unlimited plans have a fair-use limit of 600GB.

sections.label: Running out
sections.body: Buy a data boost, upgrade your plan or wait until your allowance resets on your billing date.

sections.label: Speed after fair use
sections.body: After a fair-use limit, speeds may be reduced at peak times.

sections.label: Rollover
sections.body: Unused data can roll over for a month on selected plans.

title: Check your usage
summary: Where to see how much data, minutes and texts you have used.

sections.label: In the app
sections.body: The Lumenet app shows live data used and remaining; use the home screen widget for a quick view.

sections.label: By text or code
sections.body: Text USAGE to 4000 or dial *123# for a summary.

sections.label: Usage history
sections.body: View month-by-month use in My Lumenet to choose the right plan size.

sections.label: Alerts
sections.body: Set alerts for 50%, 80% and 100% use of your allowance.

title: Hotspot and data sharing
summary: Using your phone as a Wi-Fi hotspot and sharing data between SIMs.

sections.label: Using a hotspot
sections.body: Tethering is allowed on all plans; speeds are the same as on your phone.

sections.label: Sharing data between SIMs
sections.body: Add up to four SIMs to a shared allowance on a family or business account.

sections.label: Data-only SIMs
sections.body: A separate data SIM for tablets or a mobile Wi-Fi device can be added from £5 a month.

sections.label: Limits
sections.body: Hotspot use counts towards your data allowance and fair-use limit.

title: TV packages
summary: Our Essentials, Entertainment and Premium TV packages with live channels and on-demand.

sections.label: Packages
sections.body: Essentials has 70 channels, Entertainment 130 and Premium 200, all with catch-up and on-demand libraries.

sections.label: Recording
sections.body: The Lumenet TV box records up to 300 hours and lets you pause live TV.

sections.label: Contract
sections.body: TV packages have a minimum term of 12 months, linked to broadband for bundle discounts.

sections.label: Changing package
sections.body: Upgrade at any time; downgrades take effect at the next bill.

title: Lumenet TV box and remote
summary: Setting up, using and returning the TV box and voice remote.

sections.label: Setting up
sections.body: Connect the box to your TV with the HDMI cable and to your Hub by Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

sections.label: Remote problems
sections.body: Replace the batteries, re-pair by holding Home and OK together and check the infrared window is clear.

sections.label: Software updates
sections.body: Updates install automatically overnight; leave the box in standby.

sections.label: Returning equipment
sections.body: Return the box within 30 days of cancelling using the prepaid label.

title: Sports and films add-ons
summary: Optional premium channels for sport and cinema.

sections.label: Sports add-on
sections.body: Live football, rugby, motorsport and boxing from £22 per month.

sections.label: Films add-on
sections.body: Newly released films and box sets from £9 per month on 12-month terms.

sections.label: Adding or removing
sections.body: Change add-ons in My Lumenet; removing an add-on takes effect at the end of your billing month.

sections.label: Watching on other devices
sections.body: Stream add-on content on up to four devices through the Lumenet TV app.

title: Kids and streaming apps
summary: Kids' channels, parental controls and streaming apps available on the TV box.

sections.label: Kids' pack
sections.body: Adds children's channels and a library of ad-free shows from £4 per month.

sections.label: Parental controls
sections.body: Set a PIN to restrict channels by age rating and block purchases on the TV box.

sections.label: Streaming apps
sections.body: Third-party apps are available through the TV box; you need your own subscription to use them.

sections.label: App problems
sections.body: If an app will not load, restart the box and check your internet connection.

title: Broadband and TV bundles
summary: Combining broadband and TV for a lower combined price and one bill.

sections.label: What's in a bundle
sections.body: Fibre broadband, a TV package and the TV box for a single monthly price.

sections.label: Savings
sections.body: Bundles save up to £10 a month compared with buying separately.

sections.label: Contract
sections.body: A bundle has one minimum term; leaving early affects every part of the bundle.

sections.label: Changing a bundle
sections.body: You can upgrade, add mobile, or split the bundle after the minimum term.

title: Adding mobile to your bundle
summary: Discounts for adding SIM plans to broadband or TV.

sections.label: The loyalty discount
sections.body: Add a SIM-only or phone plan for a 10% discount for each line on the account.

sections.label: Family lines
sections.body: Up to five lines on an account share one bill.

sections.label: Bringing your number
sections.body: Move your numbers across using PAC codes.

sections.label: Billing
sections.body: Mobile appears on the same bill with a section for each line.

title: Changing or cancelling TV
summary: How to downgrade, pause or end your TV service and return equipment.

sections.label: Downgrading
sections.body: Move to a smaller package at the end of your minimum term or after paying any remaining discount.

sections.label: Cancelling TV only
sections.body: Cancel the TV part and keep broadband; the bundle discount will be removed from your bill.

sections.label: Returning equipment
sections.body: Return the TV box and remote within 30 days to avoid a replacement fee.

sections.label: Final bill
sections.body: Charges for the final month are calculated pro rata and shown on your last bill.

title: Slow connection
summary: Steps to take when your broadband is slower than usual or slower than your plan.

sections.label: Quick checks
sections.body: Restart your Hub, test with a cable, and close other devices using the connection.

sections.label: Speed test
sections.body: Run the Lumenet speed test and compare with your typical evening speed and minimum guarantee.

sections.label: Causes in your home
sections.body: Old extension sockets, microfilters and devices such as cordless phones can slow your line.

sections.label: Report a fault
sections.body: If speeds are still low after the checks, report a fault in My Lumenet and we will test your line.

title: Intermittent connection
summary: What to do if your broadband keeps dropping out and reconnecting.

sections.label: Check the pattern
sections.body: Note the times and how long drops last; evening drops can point to congestion or interference.

sections.label: Check your equipment
sections.body: Test with a different cable, move the Hub away from other electronics and reinstall the microfilter.

sections.label: Line testing
sections.body: We run a line test for noise and instability and may book an engineer visit.

sections.label: Compensation
sections.body: If a fault is not fixed within two working days, you can claim automatic compensation.

title: Slow Wi-Fi or slow broadband?
summary: How to tell whether the problem is your Wi-Fi signal or the line.

sections.label: Test wired and wireless
sections.body: Plug a laptop into the Hub with a cable; if it is fast, the problem is Wi-Fi.

sections.label: Why Wi-Fi is slower
sections.body: Walls, distance and interference from neighbours' networks reduce Wi-Fi speeds.

sections.label: Improving Wi-Fi
sections.body: Place the Hub centrally, use the 5GHz band near the router and add a Wi-Fi extender if needed.

sections.label: If wired is slow too
sections.body: Report a line fault in My Lumenet.

title: Buffering and streaming problems
summary: Fixing video that freezes, buffers or drops quality.

sections.label: Check your plan speed
sections.body: HD video needs about 5Mbps per stream and 4K needs 25Mbps.

sections.label: Reduce load
sections.body: Pause downloads and other streams; fewer devices on the network improve quality.

sections.label: Other services
sections.body: If only one app is slow, the problem may be with that service rather than your broadband.

sections.label: Try the wired option
sections.body: Connect your TV or streaming device with an Ethernet cable.

title: No connection
summary: What to try if you have no internet at all.

sections.label: Check for an outage
sections.body: Check our status page and the Lumenet app for known problems in your area.

sections.label: Restart the Hub
sections.body: Switch off for 30 seconds and back on; wait five minutes for the lights to settle.

sections.label: Check cables
sections.body: Make sure all cables are firmly seated and the socket is not loose.

sections.label: Report the fault
sections.body: If it is still down, report it in My Lumenet; we aim to fix faults within two working days.

title: Router lights explained
summary: What each light on your Lumenet Hub means.

sections.label: Power light
sections.body: Solid white means on; no light means no power, so check the plug and socket.

sections.label: Internet light
sections.body: Solid white means connected; red means no connection to our network; flashing amber means searching.

sections.label: Wi-Fi light
sections.body: White shows Wi-Fi is on; blue flashing means pairing.

sections.label: Reset button
sections.body: Press and hold for 10 seconds to restore factory settings, which will remove your Wi-Fi name and password changes.

title: Phone line and socket faults
summary: Fixing problems caused by a faulty master socket, extension or line noise.

sections.label: Test socket
sections.body: Plug the Hub into the master socket with the microfilter removed; this removes extensions from the test.

sections.label: Replace the microfilter
sections.body: Faulty filters cause noise; replace with a new one from your starter pack.

sections.label: Crackling on the line
sections.body: Noise suggests a line fault; report it so we can test the line to the exchange.

sections.label: Charges
sections.body: A visit for a fault in your own wiring may be charged; we will tell you before booking.

title: Restart and factory reset
summary: How to restart or reset your Hub and when to do it.

sections.label: Restart
sections.body: Switch off for 30 seconds, then on, and wait for lights to settle before testing.

sections.label: Factory reset
sections.body: Press and hold the reset button for 10 seconds; this removes your Wi-Fi name, password and settings.

sections.label: After a reset
sections.body: Use the details on the label on the back of the Hub to reconnect your devices.

sections.label: When not to reset
sections.body: Do not reset if the Internet light is solid white and the problem is a single device.

title: Check for an outage
summary: How to see whether there is a known problem in your area.

sections.label: Check by postcode
sections.body: Enter your postcode on the status page to see any outages and expected fix times.

sections.label: Sign up for alerts
sections.body: Receive texts when an outage affects your line and when it is fixed.

sections.label: What causes outages
sections.body: Cable damage, power cuts at cabinets, severe weather and planned maintenance.

sections.label: Planned work
sections.body: Planned maintenance is announced at least seven days ahead on the status page.

title: Engineer visits
summary: What to expect when an engineer is booked and how to prepare.

sections.label: Appointment windows
sections.body: Visits are offered in morning (8am to 1pm) or afternoon (1pm to 6pm) slots.

sections.label: Getting ready
sections.body: Clear access to the socket and router and make sure someone aged 18 or over is at home.

sections.label: On the day
sections.body: You will receive a text with the engineer's name and a one-hour arrival window.

sections.label: Rearranging
sections.body: Change a visit free of charge until 6pm the working day before.

title: Missed appointments and compensation
summary: What happens if an engineer does not arrive or you miss a visit.

sections.label: If we miss the appointment
sections.body: You will receive £30 compensation automatically for each missed or cancelled-at-the-door visit.

sections.label: If you miss it
sections.body: A new visit is arranged and a £25 fee may apply for a missed appointment without 24 hours' notice.

sections.label: Claiming
sections.body: Report a missed visit in My Lumenet within 30 days; compensation appears as a credit on your next bill.

sections.label: Late engineers
sections.body: If an engineer is more than two hours late, contact us and we will rebook with priority.

title: Track your fault ticket
summary: How to see progress and the next steps on a fault you have reported.

sections.label: Where to see your ticket
sections.body: Open Faults in My Lumenet to see the status, test results and next steps.

sections.label: Ticket stages
sections.body: Reported, line test, engineer booked, engineer visited and resolved.

sections.label: Updates
sections.body: We text you at each stage; you can also message the faults team in the app.

sections.label: Closing a ticket
sections.body: Tell us if the fault is fixed; if it returns within 30 days we reopen the same ticket.

title: Automatic compensation for delays
summary: Payments when we are late to fix a loss of service, start a service or keep an appointment.

sections.label: Loss of service
sections.body: £9.76 for each full day after the second working day without service.

sections.label: Late installation
sections.body: £5 for each day after the agreed start date if the installation is delayed.

sections.label: Missed appointments
sections.body: £30 where we miss an engineer appointment.

sections.label: When you get it
sections.body: Compensation is applied automatically to your next bill.

title: Claiming other compensation
summary: How to ask for compensation if the automatic scheme does not cover your loss.

sections.label: What you can claim
sections.body: Reasonable costs that were caused directly by our failure, with receipts.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.body: Provide dates of the fault, tickets and receipts for extra costs such as mobile data.

sections.label: How to claim
sections.body: Use the compensation form in My Lumenet or contact us by message.

sections.label: If we say no
sections.body: You can complain, and take it to the independent Alternative Dispute Resolution scheme.

title: Service credits and refunds
summary: How credits are shown on your bill and how to get a refund instead.

sections.label: Where credits appear
sections.body: On your next bill as a line called Service credit.

sections.label: Asking for a refund
sections.body: Ask for any credit balance to be paid back to your bank account after your final bill.

sections.label: Credit and Direct Debit
sections.body: Credits reduce your next Direct Debit collection.

sections.label: Time limits
sections.body: Credits for compensation expire after 12 months if not used.

title: How to run an accurate speed test
summary: Step-by-step guide to testing your broadband so results are reliable.

sections.label: Before you start
sections.body: Connect a computer to the Hub with an Ethernet cable and close all other programs.

sections.label: Run three tests
sections.body: Run the Lumenet speed test at different times of day and note the results.

sections.label: Wi-Fi tests
sections.body: Test close to the Hub with only one device connected to the Wi-Fi.

sections.label: Saving evidence
sections.body: Take screenshots with the date and time to share with the faults team.

title: Understanding your speed test results
summary: What download, upload, latency and jitter results tell you.

sections.label: Download and upload
sections.body: Compare your download with your typical speed range and your upload with the plan's upload speed.

sections.label: Latency and jitter
sections.body: High latency or jitter can cause lag in calls and games even when speeds are good.

sections.label: Packet loss
sections.body: Any packet loss means data is being lost on the line; report it as a fault.

sections.label: When to report
sections.body: Report a fault if speeds stay below your minimum guarantee after three tests.

title: Speed below your minimum guarantee
summary: What we do when tests show your speed is under the guaranteed minimum.

sections.label: Submit your tests
sections.body: Send three wired speed test results from different times in My Lumenet.

sections.label: Our investigation
sections.body: We test the line, check the equipment and may send an engineer.

sections.label: 30 days to fix
sections.body: We have 30 days to bring speeds above your minimum guaranteed speed.

sections.label: Your right to leave
sections.body: If we cannot fix it, you can leave without early termination charges.

title: Move your service
summary: How to transfer your broadband, TV and mobile bundle to a new address.

sections.label: Tell us your new address
sections.body: Enter your new postcode in My Lumenet or call us; we show what is available at the new property.

sections.label: What happens to your contract
sections.body: Your contract moves with you; you pay nothing to leave when moving within our coverage.

sections.label: Timeline
sections.body: Give us at least ten working days' notice for a smooth transfer; full fibre installs can take longer.

sections.label: Costs
sections.body: A move fee of £15 applies, or £50 if a new engineer visit is needed.

title: Choose your move date
summary: How to pick a day that your broadband is switched on at the new address.

sections.label: Choosing a date
sections.body: Pick the day you get the keys or a day or two after; dates are offered from ten working days away.

sections.label: Same-day moves
sections.body: Standard moves switch your line on the chosen date by midnight.

sections.label: Changing your date
sections.body: Change the date for free until two working days before.

sections.label: If your move is delayed
sections.body: Tell us as soon as you know; we hold your order and rebook without a charge.

title: Paying for two homes
summary: How we bill when you overlap between your old and new address.

sections.label: Overlap period
sections.body: We charge only one monthly fee while moving; the old service ends on your move date.

sections.label: Keeping both
sections.body: To keep the old line, set up a second account; charges apply to each.

sections.label: Final bill at the old address
sections.body: Your last bill is pro rata, with any equipment not returned charged at the replacement rate.

sections.label: Payment
sections.body: Your Direct Debit stays in place unless you cancel it.

title: Check your new address
summary: How to find out which speeds and services you can get at the address you are moving to.

sections.label: Use the checker
sections.body: Enter your new postcode and select the address to see speeds and services available.

sections.label: Existing lines
sections.body: If the new home has an active line, we can usually switch it on without an engineer.

sections.label: New builds
sections.body: New-build homes may need a new line installed; we confirm the lead time at the order stage.

sections.label: Landlord permission
sections.body: Renters may need the landlord to agree to a new socket or ONT box.

title: No service at your new address
summary: Your options if we cannot supply your new address.

sections.label: If we cannot serve the address
sections.body: You can leave your contract without early termination charges because we cannot move your service.

sections.label: Notice
sections.body: Give us 30 days' notice of the move date and your forwarding address.

sections.label: Alternatives
sections.body: We can tell you if fixed wireless or 4G home broadband is available in the area.

sections.label: Register interest
sections.body: Register your new address and we will tell you when full fibre arrives.

title: Cancelling service at an old address
summary: How to close an account at a property you are leaving without moving it.

sections.label: Closing your account
sections.body: Give 30 days' notice in My Lumenet or by phone, with the date you want service to end.

sections.label: Early termination
sections.body: If the minimum term has not ended, early termination charges may be due unless an exemption applies.

sections.label: Special circumstances
sections.body: Bereavement, moving abroad for more than six months or entering care can reduce or remove charges.

sections.label: Final bill
sections.body: You get a final bill within 30 days, with any refund of overpayments.

title: Equipment when you move
summary: What to do with your Hub, TV box and cables when moving.

sections.label: Take it with you
sections.body: Keep the Hub and TV box; they work at your new address if you are staying with us.

sections.label: Return it if you cancel
sections.body: Return all equipment within 30 days using the freepost bag we send you.

sections.label: Equipment you leave
sections.body: Do not leave our equipment for the new occupant; unreturned items are charged at £60.

sections.label: Reset before you go
sections.body: Factory reset the Hub so your Wi-Fi details are not left behind.

title: Track your move
summary: How to see progress and status for a move you have booked.

sections.label: Where to look
sections.body: Open Moving home in My Lumenet to see the status and next step.

sections.label: Move stages
sections.body: Request received, new address checked, date confirmed, engineer booked and live.

sections.label: Changes
sections.body: Reply to our messages with any changes to your date or access arrangements.

sections.label: If something is wrong
sections.body: Contact the moves team; we aim to respond within one working day.

title: Your bill explained
summary: A guide to each section of your Lumenet bill: charges, credits and totals.

sections.label: Bill summary
sections.body: Shows the bill date, amount due, due date and any credits at the top of page one.

sections.label: Monthly charges
sections.body: Your plan, TV, add-ons and mobile lines, each listed with the period they cover.

sections.label: One-off charges
sections.body: Activation fees, engineer visits, device payments and equipment charges.

sections.label: Payment information
sections.body: Direct Debit date, balance brought forward and how to pay.

title: Why your bill has changed
summary: Common reasons your bill is higher or lower than usual.

sections.label: Part-month charges
sections.body: A first or last bill covers part of a month and can include an advance charge.

sections.label: Price changes
sections.body: An annual price increase or end of a promotional discount increases the monthly charge.

sections.label: Extra usage
sections.body: Charges for roaming, premium calls or data beyond your cap are added on the bill.

sections.label: Missed discounts
sections.body: If a promotion has ended, check My Lumenet for a loyalty price.

title: Your first bill
summary: What to expect on your first bill including activation and pro rata charges.

sections.label: When it arrives
sections.body: Within 14 days of your service going live, then monthly on the same day.

sections.label: What it includes
sections.body: Activation fee, part month of service in advance and the next full month.

sections.label: Setting up Direct Debit
sections.body: Pay the first bill by card if Direct Debit is not yet set up.

sections.label: Questions
sections.body: Contact us if the amount differs from your order confirmation.

title: Paper bills and bill formats
summary: Choose between online, paper and accessible formats.

sections.label: Online bills
sections.body: Free and available in My Lumenet and by email on the day each bill is issued.

sections.label: Paper bills
sections.body: Available for £2 per bill; free for customers over 75 or on a social tariff.

sections.label: Accessible formats
sections.body: Large print, Braille and audio bills are free on request.

sections.label: Changing
sections.body: Update your preference in My Lumenet under Bill settings.

title: Ways to pay your bill
summary: Pay by card, bank transfer, Direct Debit or at a PayPoint outlet.

sections.label: Online or app
sections.body: Pay by debit or credit card in My Lumenet or the app; payment shows immediately.

sections.label: Bank transfer
sections.body: Use the sort code and account number shown on your bill with your reference.

sections.label: Cash
sections.body: Pay with a barcode at PayPoint outlets; payment takes up to two working days.

sections.label: Phone
sections.body: Call our automated line, 24 hours a day, with your card.

title: Late and missed payments
summary: What happens if you do not pay your bill on time.

sections.label: Reminders
sections.body: We send a reminder after seven days and a final notice after 14 days.

sections.label: Late payment fee
sections.body: A £7 fee may be added if a payment is more than ten days overdue.

sections.label: Service restriction
sections.body: Mobile and TV may be restricted and broadband suspended after 30 days of non-payment.

sections.label: Getting help
sections.body: Contact us before you miss a payment; we can set up a plan or move the date.

title: Help if you are struggling to pay
summary: Support such as payment plans, social tariffs and signposting to free debt advice.

sections.label: Payment plans
sections.body: Spread what you owe over three to six months without extra interest.

sections.label: Social tariff
sections.body: A discounted plan for customers on certain benefits.

sections.label: Moving to a cheaper plan
sections.body: Change to a lower speed without penalty if you are in financial difficulty.

sections.label: Free debt advice
sections.body: We signpost free debt advice services if you want additional support.

title: Set up or change your Direct Debit
summary: How to start, change or cancel a Direct Debit.

sections.label: Setting up
sections.body: Add your bank details in My Lumenet; collection starts with your next bill.

sections.label: Changing the date
sections.body: Choose a day from the 1st to 28th; the change applies to the next bill.

sections.label: Changing the bank account
sections.body: Enter the new details and the old instruction is cancelled automatically.

sections.label: Direct Debit Guarantee
sections.body: Covers you against errors; we give ten days' notice of changes in the amount or date.

title: Failed Direct Debit
summary: What happens if the bank rejects a payment and how to put it right.

sections.label: Why it happens
sections.body: Insufficient funds, a closed account or an incorrect instruction can cause a failed collection.

sections.label: What we do
sections.body: We try again after five working days and tell you by text and email.

sections.label: Fees
sections.body: A £7 charge may apply to failed Direct Debits.

sections.label: Put it right
sections.body: Pay by card in My Lumenet and update bank details if needed.

title: Refunds and credit balances
summary: How we pay back credits after you overpay, leave or are due compensation.

sections.label: When you are in credit
sections.body: A credit appears on your account when you overpay or after a service credit.

sections.label: Asking for a refund
sections.body: Request a refund in My Lumenet; it is paid to the bank account used for payment within ten working days.

sections.label: Final bill refund
sections.body: After your final bill, any credit is refunded automatically within 30 days.

sections.label: Refund to a card
sections.body: Card refunds go back to the card used, taking up to five days to appear.

title: Pay as you go and top-ups
summary: Using mobile credit and automatic top-ups.

sections.label: How to top up
sections.body: Top up in the app, online or at shops with a voucher.

sections.label: Automatic top-up
sections.body: Set a minimum balance and amount for a payment card to be charged when credit runs low.

sections.label: Credit expiry
sections.body: Credit does not expire while you top up at least once every six months.

sections.label: Bonus credit
sections.body: Occasional top-up offers apply bonus credit that expires after 30 days.

title: Dispute a charge
summary: How to challenge something on your bill you think is wrong.

sections.label: Tell us first
sections.body: Report the item through My Lumenet or by phone, with the bill date and the charge in question.

sections.label: While we investigate
sections.body: We will not chase the disputed amount, but you should pay the undisputed part by the due date.

sections.label: Our response
sections.body: We aim to resolve billing disputes within ten working days.

sections.label: If you do not agree
sections.body: Use our complaints process and then free independent dispute resolution.

title: Independent dispute resolution
summary: Taking a complaint to a free, independent scheme after eight weeks or a deadlock letter.

sections.label: When you can go
sections.body: After eight weeks, or immediately if we issue a letter saying we cannot reach agreement.

sections.label: The scheme
sections.body: Our scheme is free and independent and the decision is binding on us, not on you.

sections.label: What to send
sections.body: Your complaint reference, bills and a short summary.

sections.label: Time limits
sections.body: Complain to the scheme within six months of our final response.

title: Your contract and minimum term
summary: What your contract says, how long the minimum term is and what you agreed to.

sections.label: Minimum term
sections.body: Most plans have a 12 or 24-month minimum term starting from the day your service goes live.

sections.label: What is included
sections.body: Your plan, price, speed, any promotions and the equipment you receive.

sections.label: Contract summary
sections.body: Download your contract summary in My Lumenet under Documents.

sections.label: Cooling-off
sections.body: You have 14 days after ordering to cancel without charge, unless service has started.

title: When your contract ends
summary: How to find your end date and what happens when your minimum term finishes.

sections.label: Finding the date
sections.body: See your end date in My Lumenet under Plan and contract.

sections.label: Reminder
sections.body: We tell you 40 to 60 days before the end date what your options are.

sections.label: If you do nothing
sections.body: You stay on a rolling plan at the out-of-contract price, which is usually higher.

sections.label: Renewing
sections.body: Choose a new deal or a rolling 30-day plan; there is no charge to switch.

title: Pausing your service
summary: Options when you are away for a long time or cannot use your service.

sections.label: Service holds
sections.body: A hold of up to three months is available on broadband for £5 a month, once per year.

sections.label: Mobile holds
sections.body: Mobile SIMs can be suspended for up to six months for £2 a month.

sections.label: What a hold does not do
sections.body: The minimum term does not stop counting during a hold, and TV cannot be paused.

sections.label: How to apply
sections.body: Request in My Lumenet at least seven days before you go.

title: Changing plan during your contract
summary: How to upgrade or move to a different plan while still in a minimum term.

sections.label: Upgrading
sections.body: Upgrade at any time; a new minimum term of 18 or 24 months may apply.

sections.label: Downgrading
sections.body: A downgrade in the minimum term may need an early change fee, unless you are in financial difficulty.

sections.label: Price effect
sections.body: The new price applies from your next bill after the change.

sections.label: How to change
sections.body: Use Change plan in My Lumenet or call us.

title: Annual price rises
summary: How and when prices change each year, and what notice we give you.

sections.label: How the rise works
sections.body: Each April, prices rise by a fixed amount in pounds and pence, stated in your contract.

sections.label: Notice we give
sections.body: We tell you at least 30 days before the rise takes effect, by email and text.

sections.label: Your right to leave
sections.body: Where a rise is not set out in pounds in your contract, you can leave without charge within 30 days.

sections.label: Checking your price
sections.body: Your new monthly price appears in My Lumenet under Plan and contract.

title: Out-of-contract pricing
summary: Why prices change when your minimum term ends and how to avoid paying more.

sections.label: What changes
sections.body: When your promotional price ends, you move to the standard price for your plan.

sections.label: Staying on the standard price
sections.body: There is no penalty for staying on the standard price, but it is often higher than new customer deals.

sections.label: Ways to pay less
sections.body: Move to a new deal, change to a cheaper plan or ask for a loyalty price.

sections.label: Reminders
sections.body: We send two reminders before your end date and show your new price in My Lumenet.

title: Leaving after a price rise
summary: When a price rise gives you the right to leave your contract without paying.

sections.label: When you can leave
sections.body: If your price rises by more than your contract allows, you can leave without early termination charges.

sections.label: Time limit
sections.body: You must tell us within 30 days of the notice of the price rise.

sections.label: How to leave
sections.body: Contact us and say you wish to leave because of a price rise; we confirm your end date.

sections.label: Equipment
sections.body: Return equipment within 30 days to avoid charges.

title: Early termination charges
summary: The fee for leaving before your minimum term ends and how it is calculated.

sections.label: How the charge works
sections.body: You pay the monthly cost for each remaining month of the minimum term, less any savings.

sections.label: Handset balance
sections.body: If you have a phone plan, you also pay the remaining handset balance.

sections.label: Getting a quote
sections.body: See your exact charge in My Lumenet under Leaving us.

sections.label: Ways to reduce it
sections.body: Move to a cheaper plan or ask us to waive some of it if you are in difficulty.

title: Leaving without a charge
summary: Situations in which you can cancel your contract without paying early termination charges.

sections.label: Faults
sections.body: If we cannot fix a fault or a speed shortfall within the time allowed, you can leave without charge.

sections.label: Price rises
sections.body: Where the price rise is not fixed in pounds, you may leave without paying.

sections.label: Moving
sections.body: If we cannot supply your new address, there is no charge.

sections.label: Bereavement or care
sections.body: We waive charges on the death of the account holder or a move into residential care.

title: Working out what you owe
summary: How to see how much to pay to end your contract at any date.

sections.label: Your leaving quote
sections.body: Choose a leave date in My Lumenet to see your charge for that date.

sections.label: What is included
sections.body: Remaining plan months, TV, add-ons and any outstanding device payments.

sections.label: Paying the charge
sections.body: The charge appears on your final bill, payable by card or Direct Debit.

sections.label: Written confirmation
sections.body: Request a letter confirming your end date and the charge by secure message.

title: Cancel your service
summary: How to cancel broadband, TV or mobile, notice periods and what to do with equipment.

sections.label: Giving notice
sections.body: Give 30 days' notice in My Lumenet or by phone; mobile needs a PAC code first.

sections.label: Cancelling part of a bundle
sections.body: Cancel TV or mobile separately; removing a part can change the price of the bundle.

sections.label: Final bill
sections.body: Your last bill includes any early charge and credit for payment made in advance.

sections.label: Returning equipment
sections.body: Return equipment within 30 days using the freepost bag we send.

title: Your Lumenet Hub
summary: An overview of the Hub router: lights, ports, buttons and what is in the box.

sections.label: What is in the box
sections.body: A Hub, power adapter, Ethernet cable and microfilter if you have a phone line.

sections.label: Ports and buttons
sections.body: Four Ethernet ports, a WAN port, a WPS button and a reset button.

sections.label: Models
sections.body: Hub 1 supports Wi-Fi 5, Hub 2 supports Wi-Fi 6 and Hub 3 supports Wi-Fi 6E with 2.5Gbps ports.

sections.label: Placing the Hub
sections.body: Keep it off the floor, away from metal and not inside a cupboard.

title: Router admin and Wi-Fi password
summary: How to find, change or recover your Wi-Fi name and password and the Hub admin login.

sections.label: Where to find the default
sections.body: The Wi-Fi name and password are on the label under your Hub.

sections.label: Changing the password
sections.body: Sign in to My Lumenet or the app and choose Wi-Fi settings, then choose a new password.

sections.label: Hub admin page
sections.body: Browse to 192.168.1.1 and use the admin password on the label.

sections.label: If you cannot sign in
sections.body: Factory reset the Hub; all your settings will return to the label defaults.

title: Wi-Fi names, channels and bands
summary: Changing the network name, 2.4 and 5GHz bands and channels to improve performance.

sections.label: Network name
sections.body: Rename your network in My Lumenet; devices then need to reconnect.

sections.label: 2.4 and 5GHz
sections.body: 2.4GHz reaches further; 5GHz is faster over shorter distances.

sections.label: Channels
sections.body: Automatic selection works for most homes; choose manually if neighbours cause interference.

sections.label: Smart connect
sections.body: Turn on to let the Hub choose the best band automatically.

title: Mesh and extenders
summary: Extend the Wi-Fi signal with mesh discs or an extender.

sections.label: Mesh discs
sections.body: Lumenet Complete Wi-Fi discs link to your Hub and create one network across the house.

sections.label: Extenders
sections.body: A plug-in extender repeats the signal; speed can drop by half.

sections.label: Placement
sections.body: Place each disc halfway between the Hub and the weak area, not in the weak area.

sections.label: Cost
sections.body: Mesh packs start at £7 a month or £120 outright.

title: Wi-Fi dead spots
summary: Why signal fades in some rooms and how to fix it.

sections.label: Causes
sections.body: Thick walls, mirrors, fish tanks and cordless phones weaken Wi-Fi signals.

sections.label: Move the Hub
sections.body: Place it centrally and at head height.

sections.label: Wired options
sections.body: Use Ethernet or powerline adapters for rooms where Wi-Fi is hard to deliver.

sections.label: Check interference
sections.body: Try a different channel or switch to 5GHz.

title: Powerline adapters
summary: Using your home's electrical wiring to extend your network.

sections.label: How they work
sections.body: A pair of adapters sends the internet signal through your mains wiring.

sections.label: Setting up
sections.body: Plug one into a wall socket next to the Hub and another where you need a connection and press the pair buttons.

sections.label: Speed and limits
sections.body: Speeds depend on wiring age; avoid extension leads for best results.

sections.label: Buying
sections.body: Available from our shop from £39 for a pair.

title: Set-up guide
summary: Step-by-step set up of your Hub, TV box and mobile device.

sections.label: Connect the Hub
sections.body: Plug in the power and connect the grey cable from your phone socket or ONT.

sections.label: Wait for the light
sections.body: The Internet light turns solid white within ten minutes.

sections.label: Connect devices
sections.body: Join the Wi-Fi using the name and password on the Hub label.

sections.label: Set up My Lumenet
sections.body: Register at My Lumenet with your account number to manage your services.

title: Faulty or replacement equipment
summary: What to do if your Hub or box stops working or arrives damaged.

sections.label: Check first
sections.body: Try a different socket and plug; if the Hub still has no lights, it may need replacing.

sections.label: Free replacement
sections.body: Faulty equipment under 24 months old is replaced free of charge within two working days.

sections.label: Damage by you
sections.body: Equipment damaged through misuse is charged at the replacement rate.

sections.label: Collection
sections.body: We include a returns bag with the new item for the old one.

title: Returning equipment
summary: How and when to return your Hub, TV box and other items after leaving.

sections.label: Return deadline
sections.body: Return within 30 days of your service ending to avoid replacement charges.

sections.label: How to return
sections.body: Use the prepaid label in your confirmation email at any Post Office or drop-off point.

sections.label: Proof of return
sections.body: Keep your receipt until we confirm receipt, which takes five working days.

sections.label: Charges
sections.body: Hub £60, TV box £80, mesh disc £30 if not returned.

title: Parental controls
summary: Block unsuitable websites and set limits for children's devices.

sections.label: Network filters
sections.body: Turn on Lumenet Safe in My Lumenet to block categories such as adult content for the whole network.

sections.label: Device profiles
sections.body: Create profiles for each child's device with age filters and daily time limits.

sections.label: Bedtime
sections.body: Set schedules to pause the internet at night.

sections.label: Limits
sections.body: Filters cannot block everything; talk to children about staying safe online.

title: Guest network
summary: Create a separate Wi-Fi network for visitors.

sections.label: Turning it on
sections.body: Enable the guest network in Wi-Fi settings and share the name and password.

sections.label: Isolation
sections.body: Guest devices cannot see devices on your main network.

sections.label: Time limits
sections.body: Set the guest network to switch off after a number of hours.

sections.label: Smart devices
sections.body: Put smart plugs and cameras on the guest network to keep them separate.

title: Wi-Fi security and updates
summary: Keeping your Hub secure with updates, strong passwords and encryption.

sections.label: Automatic updates
sections.body: The Hub updates its software overnight, so leave it switched on.

sections.label: Strong passwords
sections.body: Use at least 12 characters, avoid your name and do not reuse passwords.

sections.label: Encryption
sections.body: New Hubs use WPA3 where devices support it, falling back to WPA2.

sections.label: Remote access
sections.body: Remote management is switched off by default; turn it on only if you need it.

title: My Lumenet overview
summary: Your dashboard: services, bills, usage and anything that needs your attention.

sections.label: Your services
sections.body: Broadband, TV and mobile services on the account with plan names and prices.

sections.label: Latest bill
sections.body: Amount due, date and a link to pay or view the PDF.

sections.label: Usage
sections.body: Mobile data used and broadband speed test results.

sections.label: Needs attention
sections.body: Faults, moves, offers and tasks waiting for you.

title: My services and plan
summary: Your current plans, add-ons, contract dates and options to change.

sections.label: Plan details
sections.body: Speed, price, equipment and included extras for each service.

sections.label: Contract dates
sections.body: Start date, minimum term end date and notice period.

sections.label: Add or remove
sections.body: Add TV, mobile or Wi-Fi extenders, or remove optional extras.

sections.label: Change plan
sections.body: Compare plans and upgrade or downgrade.

title: My faults and tickets
summary: All fault tickets you have reported, with their status and next steps.

sections.label: Open tickets
sections.body: Each fault with its reference, status and expected fix time.

sections.label: Test results
sections.body: The latest line test result for each fault.

sections.label: Appointments
sections.body: Engineer visits booked, with date and time window.

sections.label: Report a new fault
sections.body: Choose the service and the type of problem to start a ticket.

title: Dropping connection fault ticket
summary: Your open fault ticket FLT-20261015-5521: dropping connection (synthetic test state).

sections.label: Ticket summary
sections.body: Reference FLT-20261015-5521, broadband, dropping connection, reported 15 October 2026.

sections.label: Status
sections.body: Engineer visit booked Thursday 22 October, 8am to 1pm; line test showed intermittent noise.

sections.label: Engineer visit
sections.body: Make sure someone aged 18 or over is home and the Hub and socket are accessible.

sections.label: Rearrange or add details
sections.body: Change the appointment or message the faults team from this page.

title: House move to new address
summary: Your pending house move MOV-20261012-0173 to 14 Orchard Lane, move date 14 November (synthetic test state).

sections.label: Move summary
sections.body: Reference MOV-20261012-0173; new address 14 Orchard Lane, Northfield; move date 14 November 2026.

sections.label: Progress so far
sections.body: Step 3 of 5: Confirm your date. Address check is complete; date and access still need confirming.

sections.label: Continue where you left off
sections.body: Confirm your move date and choose an installation appointment.

sections.label: Changing or cancelling the move
sections.body: Change the date up to two working days before, or cancel the move in this page.

title: Sign-in problems
summary: What to do if you cannot sign in to My Lumenet or the app.

sections.label: Check your details
sections.body: Use your email address or account number; passwords are case-sensitive.

sections.label: Locked out
sections.body: After five wrong attempts, accounts lock for 30 minutes.

sections.label: Two-step verification
sections.body: We send a six-digit code by text; if your number has changed, contact us.

sections.label: Register a new account
sections.body: Use your account number and postcode from a bill to register.

title: Reset your password
summary: How to choose a new password and what makes a strong one.

sections.label: Reset link
sections.body: Choose Forgotten password and we email a link valid for 30 minutes.

sections.label: Choosing a password
sections.body: Use at least 12 characters with a mix of words and numbers.

sections.label: Changing it while signed in
sections.body: Go to Security in My Lumenet and choose Change password.

sections.label: If you do not get the email
sections.body: Check spam and that you used the right email; contact us if it still fails.

title: Secure a hacked account
summary: What to do if someone else has been using your account or you think your login has been stolen.

sections.label: Act straight away
sections.body: Change your password, sign out of all devices and turn on two-step verification.

sections.label: Contact us
sections.body: Tell us what you saw; we can lock the account while we investigate and reverse changes.

sections.label: Check your bank
sections.body: Look for unrecognised payments and tell your bank if card details may be at risk.

sections.label: Protect other accounts
sections.body: Change passwords for any other service where you use the same password.

title: Scam calls, texts and emails
summary: How to spot fake messages that pretend to be from Lumenet and what to do.

sections.label: Signs of a scam
sections.body: Urgent threats, links to unfamiliar sites and requests for card details, passwords or remote access.

sections.label: What we will never do
sections.body: We never ask for your password or full card number, or ask you to install software to fix a fault.

sections.label: If you have responded
sections.body: Contact your bank, change passwords and report to Action Fraud.

sections.label: Report it
sections.body: Forward suspicious texts to 7726 and emails to the address on our website.

title: Personal details and marketing choices
summary: Update your name, address, phone, email and how we contact you.

sections.label: Contact details
sections.body: Update email and mobile in My Lumenet; we send a code to confirm the change.

sections.label: Name changes
sections.body: We need a marriage certificate or deed poll to change the name on the account.

sections.label: Marketing
sections.body: Choose which channels we may use for offers; service messages are always sent.

sections.label: Your data rights
sections.body: Ask for a copy of your data or deletion, subject to what we must keep by law.

title: Contact us
summary: Phone, chat, secure message and store details for each Lumenet service.

sections.label: Phone
sections.body: Call 01632 960 400 for sales, 01632 960 500 for faults and 01632 960 600 for billing (fictional numbers).

sections.label: Chat and messages
sections.body: Use the app or My Lumenet for live chat during opening hours and messages at any time.

sections.label: Write to us
sections.body: Lumenet Customer Care, 8 Canal Street, Northfield, NF1 4CD (fictional address).

sections.label: Relay and sign language
sections.body: Use Relay UK 18001 or a free BSL video call during opening hours.

title: Opening times
summary: When the phone lines, chat and stores are open.

sections.label: Faults line
sections.body: Open every day 8am to 10pm, including bank holidays.

sections.label: Sales and billing
sections.body: Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm, Saturday and Sunday 9am to 5pm.

sections.label: Stores
sections.body: Open Monday to Saturday 9am to 5.30pm, Sunday 11am to 4pm.

sections.label: Quietest times
sections.body: Early morning and mid-afternoon tend to have the shortest waits.

title: Make a complaint
summary: How to complain about service, billing or sales and what happens next.

sections.label: How to complain
sections.body: Use the complaint form in My Lumenet, phone or write to us with your account number and what went wrong.

sections.label: What we do
sections.body: We acknowledge your complaint within two working days and aim to resolve it in ten.

sections.label: Compensation
sections.body: If we got something wrong we may apologise, fix it and pay compensation.

sections.label: Our final response
sections.body: A final response letter or deadlock letter is sent after eight weeks at the latest.

title: If you are not satisfied
summary: What to do when you are unhappy with our final response.

sections.label: Ask for a review
sections.body: Reply to the final response and ask for a senior manager to review.

sections.label: Independent scheme
sections.body: Take your complaint to our free alternative dispute resolution service after eight weeks.

sections.label: Regulator information
sections.body: You can report problems with providers to Ofcom, which monitors complaints.

sections.label: Keep records
sections.body: Keep reference numbers, dates and names for any contact.

title: Accessibility and alternative formats
summary: Bills, letters and contact in formats that work for you.

sections.label: Formats
sections.body: Large print, Braille, audio and easy read versions of bills and letters at no cost.

sections.label: Contact options
sections.body: Text relay, video relay in BSL, chat and email as alternatives to phone calls.

sections.label: Accessible equipment
sections.body: Large-button phones and TV remotes with high-contrast text.

sections.label: Tell us once
sections.body: We keep your preferences on your account so you do not need to repeat them.

title: Priority support services
summary: Fast fault repair and extra help for customers who are vulnerable or depend on a connection for health reasons.

sections.label: Who qualifies
sections.body: Customers who are elderly, disabled, have a long-term health condition or rely on telecare.

sections.label: What you get
sections.body: Priority fault repair, a dedicated phone line and a free battery backup for phone service.

sections.label: Registering
sections.body: Apply in My Lumenet or call us; we may ask for evidence from a medical professional.

sections.label: During a power cut
sections.body: Landline services need a battery backup; mobile signal may remain available.

title: Bereavement and power of attorney
summary: Support if the account holder has died or someone else manages your account.

sections.label: After a death
sections.body: A relative or executor can contact our bereavement team with a copy of the death certificate.

sections.label: Early termination charges
sections.body: We waive early termination charges when the account holder has died.

sections.label: Power of attorney
sections.body: A registered attorney can manage an account with the registered document.

sections.label: Third-party authority
sections.body: Add a trusted person to speak for you on the account.

title: Find a store
summary: Where to get help in person, collect orders or return equipment.

sections.label: Store locator
sections.body: Search by postcode to find stores, opening times and services.

sections.label: What stores can do
sections.body: Help with set up, SIM swaps, returns and plan changes.

sections.label: Booking an appointment
sections.body: Reserve a time slot for popular services.

sections.label: Accessibility
sections.body: Stores have step-free access and hearing loops.

title: Guides and community
summary: Self-help guides, videos and a customer community.

sections.label: Help centre
sections.body: Search guides on set-up, faults, billing and mobile.

sections.label: Video tutorials
sections.body: Short videos covering Hub set-up, Wi-Fi and the app.

sections.label: Community
sections.body: Ask other customers; Lumenet staff answer in weekday office hours.

sections.label: Guides for older customers
sections.body: Large-text guides and a telephone coaching service.
